sb_prompt: FIND OUT WHAT THE OTHER CALLER DOES IN THE WAY OF LAWN AND GARDEN WORK.DOES THE OTHER CALL ENJOY DOING IT?  COMPARE THIS TO YOUR OWN SITUATION.
raw_output:
ParticipantA: Hello!
ParticipantB: Hi there.
ParticipantA: Hey, sorry to bother you, but I'm trying to find out what you do in the way of lawn and garden work. Does that happen to be your thing?
ParticipantB: Oh, uh, not really. I work as a pharmacist, actually.
ParticipantA: Oh, nice. That's pretty cool. I'm a grocery store manager.
ParticipantB: Right. So, how does that involve gardening at all?
ParticipantA: Well, I manage the produce section mostly, but I do help keep the store windows and a little plot out back looking decent.
ParticipantB: Hmm. I see. I've got a friend who's into it; he's got this huge plot behind his place.
ParticipantA: Oh yeah? Does he enjoy doing it?
ParticipantB: Sometimes. Honestly, a little bit of it. We've been talking about it, but he says it's more of a chore than a hobby.
ParticipantA: That makes sense. I feel the same way. I used to think I'd love gardening, but then I tried it and my back gave out after an hour.
ParticipantB: Yeah, I get that. My friend complains about the weeds and the bugs all the time.
ParticipantA: True. I've told a few people that story about the back plot failing on me. It's just hard work.
ParticipantB: Yeah, it is. I'm glad I stuck to the medicine side of things. No digging for me.
ParticipantA: Me too. It's nice not to have to worry about the weather ruining your day.
ParticipantB: Exactly. So, does your store have any specific garden stuff you manage?
ParticipantA: Mostly just keeping the display tables clean and maybe planting some seasonal flowers in the windows to make them look nice.
ParticipantB: Oh, that's a good use of it. You make it look good for the customers.
ParticipantA: Yeah, that's the goal. Just a little bit of green. Nothing like the heavy lifting.
ParticipantB: Right. I'm with you on that. My friend might enjoy it, but I definitely don't.
ParticipantA: I guess we're both lucky we don't have to deal with the dirt that much.
ParticipantB: Yeah, sounds like a plan. Thanks for chatting about this.
ParticipantA: No problem. Take care.
ParticipantB: You too. Bye.
